assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original SCORPIO zodiac fantasy bow concept for a Skyrim solid-light weapon collection. Input image is an aesthetic reference ONLY: elegant coherent luminous silhouette, substantial broad geometric surfaces, compact comfortable continuous one-hand grip, crisp beveled glowing edges, luxurious black negative spaces, no cumbersome attachments. Do not copy its helix or diamond cages. One complete single upright bow on a pure black background, limbs to LEFT, thin taut straight string on RIGHT joining both pointed tips, portrait 2:3, full silhouette with generous margins. Clean near-side view with slight depth revealing dimensional construction. Entire object composed of thick planar geometric solid light, smoothly curved faceted ribbons, purposeful sharp edges and generous cut-through spaces; not flimsy wires. Scorpio is abstracted into subtle pincer shoulders, tapering curved tail profiles and small stinger tips, never a literal animal sculpture. Restrained soft halo, saturated readable body faces, brighter colored edges, no overexposed white glow. No wood, leather, ordinary metal, floral or animal textures, ornamental engravings, hexagram, giant rings, chains, repeated polygon hoop chains, characters, hands, arrows, text or watermark. Show only a few crisp small local particles around limb shoulders, not a cloud obscuring design. Four color collection, this image depicts one weapon. Palette: deep scarlet and crimson broad faces, hot rose-red edge accents, no orange/yellow. Design: SCARLET PINCER. Slim waisted faceted solid grip. Above and below the hand, each shoulder splits into two short swept pointed jaws enclosing a long angular almond-shaped opening; one jaw folds over the other slightly, then both join the limb smoothly. Each limb is a single long broad saber-like tail ribbon curving outward into a strong recurve, with a second shorter inner blade nesting closely alongside its lower half; narrow triangular negative space between blades. Two large shallow angular facets along each tail imply articulated tension WITHOUT adding many armor segments. Final limb third turns inward toward a compact scorpion-stinger point anchoring the string. Elegant, aggressive clean two-blade silhouette, top and bottom balanced, no helical braid. Particles: small sharp crimson triangular sparks and tiny rose slivers just outside pincer shoulders.
